children: Borrelli, who was appointed to the board of Greatland Gold in April 2016, sold the shares at an average price of 700.03p each, for a total value of £3.68m.
Following the transaction, Borrelli holds a beneficial interest in 1.24m ordinary Greatland shares.
As of 1445 BST, Greatland shares were down 2.41% at 586.50p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
